title: incident-bot: compact on-call autodiagnostics summary + runbook suggestion ranking
author: Priya Desai
description:
Motivation: on-call engineers need a concise diagnostics summary when alerts fire; the existing incident-bot reply is verbose and sometimes buries the actionable items. This change adds a compact autodiagnostics summary card and a ranked runbook suggestion layer that surfaces the most likely runbooks based on SLO signals, recent alerts, and observed telemetry patterns.

What this PR does: compact summary: - Adds a short diagnostics summary (1-3 bullets) with top signals (error spike, latencies, client error ratio) and a recommended next step. runbook ranking: - Introduces a ranking model for runbook suggestions using heuristics (SLO overlap, service ownership, recent matches) and simple score boosts for exact tag matches. Integration hooks: - Exposes an API for downstream tools (slo-toolkit) to annotate suggestions with confidence and suggested play. UX tweaks: - Adds a collapsible detailed section showing the full diagnostic output and links to full telemetry dashboards. Tests and rollout: - Unit tests for ranking and summary generation. e2e smoke job that simulates alert -> bot flow. Feature gate: lightweight feature flag (incident.autodiag.compact_summary) for gradual rollout.

Checklist: - [x] Feature implementation - [x] Unit + integration tests - [x] CI green - [x] Docs: updated incident-bot runbook links doc - [x] Canary rollout to prod-tilt

Related: ENG-8221 (compact diagnostics), SRE-303 (runbook ranking), SUP-1120 (customer oncall support request).

release_notes: Adds compact on-call diagnostics summaries and ranked runbook suggestions (feature-gated). Improves on-call triage speed by surfacing top signals and recommended next steps. Backwards-compatible and controlled via `incident.autodiag.compact_summary`.
